Solution: On the unit circle, reversing the angle negates the y-coordinate and preserves the x-coordinate. Thus sine is odd and cosine is even. Adding pi negates both coordinates and preserves their ratio, so tangent has period pi wherever defined. sin(-theta)=-sin(theta).

Solution: Tangent is y/x on the unit circle. After a half-turn both signs reverse and the ratio is unchanged, so its least positive period is pi. The fundamental period is pi.

Question Choices: What is the fundamental period of cos(x)? Angles are in radians.
Hints: Cosine repeats after a full turn.|A full rotation is 2pi radians.
Solution: In radians, the least positive period of sin(Bx) or cos(Bx) is 2pi/abs(B), for nonzero B. Consecutive peaks are one period apart. The fundamental period is 2pi.
